attack.name: Sporefall

pattern.burstDesc: A visible shimmer pours from under the cap and drifts outward. Breathe it and the trees start talking.

attack.telegraph: The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers.

attacks.name: Sporefall

pattern.burstDesc: A visible shimmer pours from under the cap and drifts outward. Breathe it and the trees start talking.

attacks.telegraph: The gills begin to breathe — a sweet, wrong smell rolls out from under the cap. The air shimmers.

attacks.name: Cap Slam

pattern.directDesc: The whole cap comes down like a hammer. Slow, but the cap is the size of a cartwheel.

attacks.telegraph: The cap tilts. The stem creaks like a ship's mast. Get out from under it.

codexStages.observed: A fly agaric grown monstrous. The System found the forest's most recognizable mushroom and decided it needed to be MORE — a red cap the size of a cartwheel, warts like knucklebones, a stem thick as a sapling, gills that visibly breathe. It does not chase. It does not need to. The spores do the traveling.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Sporefall (drifting spore cloud — disorienting, keep your distance), Cap Slam (slow, devastating, telegraphed by the tilting cap). It is nearly sessile — speed is its weakness and the spore cloud its kingdom. Strike the stem: cut it and the cap can't aim. Fire dries it out. Never eat the flesh — the spores alone are a trip you don't come back from.
codexStages.unknown: A red moon rose between the trees. It was breathing.

counter.hint: The cloud drifts — it can't chase you. Watch the wind.
counter.reveal: The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap.

curious: The cap turns toward you, slowly, like a sunflower following something it shouldn't.
fearful: The gills flutter. Spores jet in a panic — it's afraid, and making the air afraid with it.
warn: A sweet smell, suddenly strong. The warts seem to lean toward you.

edible.note: Do not eat the monster mushroom. The flesh is ibotenic sponge — the spores alone are a trip you don't come back from.

encounter.comment: Sessile-ish bruiser: the threat is the drifting spore cloud, not the chase. keep_distance is engine-observed movement.
encounter.knownCue: When the gills breathe and the air shimmers, the cloud is coming.
encounter.knownTactics: Stay out of the sporefall. Strike the stem while it recovers.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).

name: Murkcap
unknown: a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
vibe: a fairy-tale mushroom with the fairy tale removed
weaknesses: the stem — cut the stem and the cap can't aim the slam
it barely moves — the cloud is the whole fight, and clouds don't chase

counter.hint: The crown is wide and the forest is thick. He cannot turn mid-charge.
counter.reveal: His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free.

name: Rut King

attack.name: Crown Charge
attack.telegraph: He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath.

pattern.chargeDesc: Straight-line royal demolition. The rack is too wide to turn.

attacks.name: Crown Charge
attacks.telegraph: He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath.

pattern.chargeDesc: Straight-line royal demolition. The rack is too wide to turn.

attacks.name: Bellow
attacks.telegraph: His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something.

pattern.burstDesc: A bone-shaking roar. Leaves fall. You forget which way is up.

attacks.name: Antler Sweep
attacks.telegraph: He tosses his head — the crown whistles sideways through the air.

pattern.directDesc: The rack sweeps a full arc. Close is worse than far.

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.telegraph: He tosses his head, snorts, and backs into the treeline — crown high. A king does not die in the mud; he will be back in the rut.

weaknesses: the rack catches on trees — fight near trunks
the bellow needs breath — the inhale is the tell
he cannot turn mid-charge — never stand in the lane

edible.note: The crown is bone and vanity, but the haunches are venison fit for a king. Literally.

codexStages.unknown: Something wearing a crown of bone bellowed at the moon. The leaves fell off the trees.
codexStages.observed: A red deer stag the System crowned — literally. It watched the rut and concluded the forest needed a king, so it grew his rack into a tangled crown and never let the rut end. He collects tribute (the shiniest things, the best grazing) and answers every challenge. Vain, territorial, unstoppable in a straight line.
codexStages.slain: Moves: Crown Charge (heavy, telegraphed, destroys everything in a straight lane — the rack is too wide to turn), Bellow (sonic burst, disorienting — the long inhale is the tell), Antler Sweep (close range, punishing), Withdraw (below 25% hp, may return). The crown catches on trunks — keep a tree between you. Strike during the bellow's inhale. Never stand in the lane. Meat: excellent. The crown is a trophy worth hauling.

unknown: something wearing a crown of bone, bellowing at the dusk
vibe: royalty as a contact sport — vain, magnificent, furious

curious: He regards you down the length of his nose. You are being evaluated as a subject or a rival.
warn: The bellow rolls out — not at you, at the whole forest. You happen to be in the forest.
fearful: He backs a step, crown high. Even kings reconsider.

encounter.knownTactics: Give it a tree — the rack catches. Strike during the bellow inhale.
encounter.comment: Charge-lane bruiser with a sonic opener. sidestep is engine-observed movement off the telegraph lane.
encounter.knownCue: The long inhale before the bellow — that is your moment.

loot.note: Alien loot: low chance, tier scales with monster strength (Steve 2026-10-05).
